verseText: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
meaning: Because of Adam's sin all people die, but through Jesus Christ those who belong to him will have forever life.

recall.question: In whom will people be made alive?

meaning.question: What contrast is this verse making?
choices: Death came through Adam, life through Christ
Adam and Christ did the same thing

application.prompt: When you think about death, remember the hope of forever life that comes through Christ.
